notes: no «ح» is written: the second isnad after «‏.» is read as a taḥwīl meeting at يونس, the Zuhri tail is written once after it (rule 3)
«أن حسين بن علي أخبره أن عليا قال» : the Companion whose words are relayed is the last link; «عليهم السلام» is a blessing, left out
«زيد بن حارثة» and Hamza are people in the scene, not links
